data.name: Whispers of the Fall
data.detailed_description:
WHISPERS OF THE FALL

Some whispers are better left unheard.

Enter a disturbing world where reality and nightmare become indistinguishable. In Whispers of the Fall, a first-person psychological horror puzzle game, you must explore the darkest corners of the human mind while an ancient, malevolent presence threatens to consume everything you believe is real.

Trapped within a haunting journey inspired by temptation, fear, and the fall of humanity, you must uncover hidden truths, solve mysterious puzzles, and face the darkness lurking within.

Every shadow holds a secret. Every whisper draws you deeper.

EXPLORE A WORLD OF PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR

Venture through eerie corridors and unsettling environments where the boundaries between reality and illusion begin to collapse.

Surrounded by oppressive darkness and mysterious whispers, you'll never feel entirely alone.

SOLVE MYSTERIOUS PUZZLES

Your survival depends on your ability to think clearly when everything around you feels wrong.

Uncover clues, unravel cryptic riddles, and piece together the mysteries hidden within this nightmarish world.

Each discovery takes you closer to the disturbing truth.

FACE AN ANCIENT EVIL

Inspired by the story of humanity's first temptation, Whispers of the Fall explores the sinister influence of Shaytan — a malevolent force that feeds on doubt, fear, and temptation.

As you descend deeper into the unknown, the line between your own thoughts and the whispers of evil becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish.

KEY FEATURES

  • First-Person Psychological Horror: Experience a disturbing adventure through an immersive first-person perspective.

  • Atmospheric Exploration: Discover ominous environments filled with shadows, mystery, and supernatural dread.

  • Challenging Puzzles: Solve cryptic riddles and uncover secrets hidden throughout your journey.

  • Dark Supernatural Story: Experience a psychological nightmare inspired by temptation, fear, and ancient evil.

  • Immersive Horror Atmosphere: Unsettling sounds, eerie visuals, and mysterious whispers create a constant sense of unease.

The darkness is calling.

Will you uncover the truth, or become another soul lost to the whispers?

Enter Whispers of the Fall.
